meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会接入 Linear：它在指定团队的 issue 评论线程里活动，每条评论都会触发它（无需 @提及），回复落在对应 issue 线程中；每个 issue 评论线程是独立会话，不先发欢迎语。
howto.when: 当你要求把 Linear 接入、或在已接好的 Linear 团队里给某条 issue 评论时触发；后者会由 webhook 自动接管，无需 @提及。

say.text: 帮我把 Linear 频道接进来，用 OAuth 应用身份发帖
say.note: 会走 Apply 与凭证配置步骤

say.text: 改用 Personal API Key 接 Linear，团队键是 ENG
say.note: 改为 LINEAR_API_KEY 路径，你的评论被过滤

say.text: Linear 评论一直没到 agent，帮我排查一下
say.note: 会先查 webhook 与签名密钥配置

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude works inside Linear issue comment threads: every comment on an issue in the wired team triggers it (no @-mention), replies go to that issue's thread, and each thread is an isolated session.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Linear, and afterwards when a comment lands on an issue in the wired Linear team — via webhook, with no @-mention needed.

say_en.text: Add the Linear channel and post as an OAuth app identity
say_en.note: Runs the Apply and credentials steps

say_en.text: Set up Linear with a Personal API Key instead, team key ENG
say_en.note: Switches to LINEAR_API_KEY; your comments get filtered

say_en.text: Comments aren't reaching the agent in Linear, help me debug
say_en.note: Checks the webhook and signing secret first
